answers.core: This just seems like a feature that should exist in every single game engine/editor. It's the basics of basics in my eyes. This feature not existing can lead someone to being stuck for days or weeks trying to figure out how do a workaround. Just like it made myself stuck.
answers.workaround: Right now you can do dirty workarounds like storing a collisions list in some resource file where we define polygons for different collision ids, or creating a whole new tileset and applying transparent tiles on top of tiles, which could lead to worse performance.

title: Allow TileSets to have a "collisions" set, which can be re-used by multiple tiles
